environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application code deployed via legacy migration pipeline. Process is launched inside a pivot_root namespace where the effective root is /opt/chroot/app-cage. The chroot directory tree contains only: JRE runtime jars (rt.jar, etc.), application WAR contents, a minimal /tmp (noexec,nosuid mounted tmpfs, 10MB), and /dev/null + /dev/urandom. No shell binaries exist within the namespace (/bin/sh, /bin/bash, /usr/bin/python, etc. are absent). /proc is mounted read-only with hidepid=2. The process runs under a dedicated UID (65534) with supplementary group membership restricted via setgroups deny in the user namespace. Additionally, a seccomp-bpf profile is attached at process start that allows only: read, write, open, close, stat, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, dup2, getpid, socket, connect, sendto, recvfrom, bind, listen, accept, clone (CLONE_VM|CLONE_FS only), futex, epoll_create, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, and exit_group. Notably, execve/execveat are NOT in the allowlist. Network egress from the instance is restricted by a VPC security group that permits only outbound TCP 443 to a prefix list (pl-02cd2c6b) corresponding to S3 gateway endpoints and the DynamoDB gateway endpoint in us-east-1.

config.network_egress: TCP 443 to pl-02cd2c6b (S3/DynamoDB VPC endpoints only)
